bug_summary: intersectの内部_mergeがvalue1を直接書き換えていたため、frozenなオブジェクト/配列を渡すとstrict modeでTypeErrorになる (mutation bug)
pr_title: Avoid extra allocations in intersect merge
pr_description: Update `_merge` to write merged object and array entries directly onto `value1` instead of first spreading it into a fresh `nextValue`. Saves an allocation per merge call on both the object and array branches, since the accumulated result is returned as-is at the end.
